title: Active Learning Methods for Efficient Data Utilization and Model Performance Enhancement

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Sensitive attributes and Minority groups)
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the predictive parity and accuracy of different active learning sampling strategies (such as BALD, uniform labeling, and gradient reversal techniques) on minority groups and sensitive attributes using a balanced held-out set.

Reviewing literature on how active learning data collection strategies can exacerbate existing biases, and examining mitigation frameworks that use novel weighting, multi-armed bandits, and noise inclusion to correct statistical and algorithmic bias.
